business.signups.label: SelectaDJ for Business sign-up
business.signups.about: Self-serve business sign-up and selling of business plans. Off until the legal review passes; pilots work without it.

business.start.label: Business start page
business.start.about: The /business/start page: while sign-up is off, a pilot contact form that emails REX Technologies; once sign-up is on, naming a new organisation.

business.orgs.label: Organisations, venues, zones and crates
business.orgs.about: An organisation workspace with its venues, each venue's zones, and organisation and venue crates drawn from one shared library.

business.zones.label: Zone playback
business.zones.about: One playback session per business zone: a kiosk or a staff member's browser plays a zone, remotes steer the zones in their scope, and the home kiosk takes its zone back at a song boundary.

business.schedules.label: Venue schedules and programmes
business.schedules.about: Opening hours, holiday exceptions, stay-open-late and close-now overrides, plus zone programmes and state.

business.entitlements.label: Business allowances and continuity
business.entitlements.about: Pooled storage that grows with venues, paid zone limits, the opening-hours processing weight, the usage meters for managers, and the monthly continuity figure with service credits proposed for staff approval.

business.offline.label: Offline zone controls
business.offline.about: Kiosk players keep about four hours of music saved ahead with a signed offline permit, so the music never stops when the venue internet drops; plus offline manifests, command resync and cache reports. Off, a player keeps only the next three songs and plays only while connected.

business.kiosk.label: Kiosk players
business.kiosk.about: Pair a small dedicated player to a zone with a code; it starts the music by itself, reports its health, keeps saved music for outages and tells managers when a zone goes quiet.

business.workspaces.label: Workspace switcher
business.workspaces.about: Switch between your personal SelectaDJ and the organisations you belong to. Personal and business data never mix.

business.billing.label: Business billing
business.billing.about: The owner and admin billing page: quantities and prices, a cost preview before adding venues, zones or seats, PO number and cost centres for invoices, a cost breakdown CSV, and dunning that stops a venue only at its close after warnings. Stripe test mode only.

business.licensing.label: Licensing and play logs
business.licensing.about: Music licences gate when a venue may start playing, with reminders and the owner's one-off extension; every play is logged with its source and kept 3 years by default; owners, admins and venue managers download a venue's play log as CSV; ISRC entry and coverage; acceptance of the business terms.

business.roles.label: Business people and roles
business.roles.about: The People page: owners, admins and venue managers invite people by link into a role at chosen venues, see seats, revoke invitations and remove someone, which signs them out at once.

business.devices.shared.label: Shared staff tablets and PINs
business.devices.shared.about: A staff member confirms an action on a shared tablet with their personal venue PIN, so the activity log names them.

business.console.label: Business HQ console
business.console.about: The multi-venue overview for owners, admins and viewers: venue health, zone states and what needs attention.

business.venue_view.label: Venue manager view
business.venue_view.about: One venue's page for its managers: now playing, schedule, rules, devices and people.

business.staff_controls.label: Staff quick controls
business.staff_controls.about: The staff screen for a venue: skip, steer, volume within the cap, requests, and Play here to make this browser the zone's speaker.

business.mix_exports.label: Business mix exports
business.mix_exports.about: Lets a business organisation save a mix as a file, which could be redistributed. Off by default; also needs the owner's setting.

business.pilots.label: Business pilots
business.pilots.about: REX Technologies staff create free pilot organisations with their venues and zones, using the same model a paying venue will.

business.content_controls.label: Venue content controls
business.content_controls.about: Organisation and venue music rules, the blocklist, 24-hour overrides, explicit flags from managers and file tags, and each zone's volume cap with quiet hours.

business.content_controls.bulk.label: Bulk explicit editor and CSV import
business.content_controls.bulk.about: Mark many organisation songs explicit, clean or not checked at once with a count and undo, and import marks from a CSV matched by ISRC, then artist and title.

business.content_controls.lyrics_hint.label: Worth checking list
business.content_controls.lyrics_hint.about: Lists organisation songs whose lyrics contain words on a review list, for a person to check. It never marks a song clean or explicit by itself.

business.rooms.label: Rooms for Business
business.rooms.about: Standing guest request rooms for business zones: guests join with a table-card code, staff approve or pass requests, and managers set modes and limits.

business.rooms.branding.label: Rooms for Business branding
business.rooms.branding.about: The venue's logo, colour and welcome line on the guest request page.

business.rooms.print.label: Rooms for Business print sheet
business.rooms.print.about: A printable sheet of table cards with each zone's join code.

business.rooms.screen_code.label: Rooms for Business screen code
business.rooms.screen_code.about: A rotating join code shown on the zone's display screen.
